prompt: Who was previously appointed prime minister of the United Kingdom, becoming the first one to win a general election since Tony Blair in 2005?
answer: Keir Starmer was appointed prime minister of the United Kingdom on July 5, 2024, becoming the first Labour leader to win a general election since Tony Blair in 2005.
